evaluation_aperture.note_en: The imaging request launches a disc one source beam radius wide, so the diffraction model evaluates the near-axis core of the stop cone, not the whole f/2 pupil. The numbers in this case describe that evaluated cone.
evaluation_aperture.note_zh: 成像请求只发射一个光源光束半径宽的圆盘，因此衍射模型评估的是光阑锥的近轴核心，而非整个 f/2 孔径；本案例的数字都对应这个被测锥。

assumptions: the traced rays of a uniformly lit pupil; the geometric MTF stands for the MTF where the wavefront error is large
models.name: geometric ray bundle of the traced rays

assumptions: |sum over the rays of p_j exp(-i 2 pi f (r_j - r_c))|, p_j each ray's share of the irradiance on the pupil

assumptions: a point object lights the pupil uniformly; each ray carries the irradiance its field keeps to the plane (a sample's amplitude, the interfaces' and coatings' transmissions); a partially polarized or unpolarized source's two components are mutually incoherent: each component's pupil field is propagated to the image apart and their point spread functions add in irradiance, each by its share of the light that reaches the plane
each ray stands for the solid angle its tube fills in image space and carries the phase of its optical path difference

monochromatic: one spectral line per field
scalar field: image-space sine at most the scalar limit
